questions.question: In your work on TradeCORE Pro, how did you design the server-side components, servlets, and stored procedures, and what specifically led to the 12% reduction in server load?
Describe the cross-platform interface you spearheaded between UNIX- and Windows-based systems. What integration challenges did you encounter, and how did you resolve them?

Your ContentCORE Server used JMS and TCP for real-time peer-to-peer XML content distribution. How did you implement message redundancy and guaranteed delivery, and how would you assess those mechanisms in a high-volume payments environment?

Fiserv processes latency-sensitive acquiring transactions at high throughput. How would you approach designing a resilient Java or C/C++ service that maintains predictable response times during peak traffic and partial dependency failures?
Tell us about your experience developing the Quartermaster Online Banking Engine, particularly your collaboration with security specialists and compliance teams during delivery.
What production-support responsibilities have you held for financial applications, and how do you investigate, mitigate, and communicate a high-severity incident affecting transaction processing?
Describe how you have provided technical leadership to junior engineers. How did you set technical direction, review work, and improve the quality of delivered software?

When balancing feature commitments against technical investment, such as reliability, performance, or platform modernization, how would you prioritize work and explain the trade-offs to business stakeholders?
What is your experience with Java Enterprise Edition, C/C++, and UNIX/Linux development, and which kinds of services or modules would you be most comfortable owning hands-on in this role?

This role requires partnership with architecture, DevOps, production support, and peer platform teams. Can you give an example of coordinating across multiple technical and business groups to deliver an application or major enhancement on time?
